name: ywm
description: Search queries, indexing history, SQI, diagnostics and broken links from Yandex.Webmaster. Read-only; run ywm_oauth_start after install.

YANDEX_CLIENT_ID.title: Yandex OAuth app ID
YANDEX_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth app from oauth.yandex.ru. Shared with the metrika plugin.

YANDEX_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Yandex OAuth app secret
YANDEX_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret of the same OAuth app.

YWM_HOST_ID.title: Default host
YWM_HOST_ID.description: Webmaster host id, format https:example.com:443 — see ywm_hosts.
